description: This file contains unit tests for the RecruitmentAttachmentDao class in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, specifically testing CRUD operations related to vacancy attachments.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the RecruitmentAttachmentDao data access object in the recruitment plugin of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a new instance of RecruitmentAttachmentDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a vacancy attachment and verifies the returned object and its properties.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentContentById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a vacancy attachment by ID, checking file name and type.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Checks multiple retrieved attachments for a specific vacancy ID, validating count and attributes.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple vacancy attachments by their IDs and verifies that they are removed.
